messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Running R Studio as a complete Web Application with a single click in Shiny
parts:
You would create an Amazon EC2 AMI with RStudio pre-configured, then write some R code for launching a new AMI (you would need to prompt for Amazon credentials). This would have absolutely nothing to do with Shiny though.

RStudio Desktop is pretty easy to install. Is there a reason you can't just be using that?
